Ghar ghar bichhe farsh-e-aza

Ya maatam Husain ka

Yehi charagh jaleṅge

Azaadaar qaafila
Yehi charagh jaleṅge

Qaasim ka gham Asghar ka gham

Sog Aal-e-Mustafa ka

Yehi charagh jaleṅge

Ahl-e-haram balwa-e-aam
Hum yaad rakheṅge tamaam
Bint-e-Ali ke khutbe
Na bhuleṅge ba khuda
Yehi charagh jaleṅge
Tum bhi Jawaad o Shaadmaaṅ
Nauhoṅ ki do mil kar azaaṅ

Yehi charagh jaleṅge\"\"\".splitlines()

item.text:
Audited all 50 verses against the Urdu. Removed the extra Roman opening, “Ae ahl-e-aza, ae ahl-e-aza,” because it has no corresponding Urdu verse. The Roman and Urdu now align line by line.

Corrected Roman spellings, nasal vowels, and izafat, and set the Urdu title with a Roman alternate title. Preserved the Urdu body and its existing unnumbered layout. Human editorial sign-off is pending.
